x-bump-note:
1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 (plan pln-deferrals-carry-both-sides-and-7d1c7e) adds the optional `case_against` string — the argument that lost, carried through when a plan deferral is harvested into this queue, so a triager sees both sides rather than only the surviving `proposed_action`. Additive: every record valid under 1.1.0 remains valid under 1.2.0. The claude-klabauter-side harvest CLI cannot populate this field yet (see the plan's C8 memo); it is therefore OPTIONAL, not required — a required field here would reject every entry the current CLI writes.

1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 widened the `change_kind` enum by two members — `verification` (a ratified deferral whose deliverable is evidence rather than a diff) and `config-edit` — and expanded that field's description to name docs/wiki/lessons-outbox-schema.md § Change-kind enum as the enum's SSOT. Additive to the value domain of an existing field: every record valid under 1.0.0 remains valid under 1.1.0. No closed-vocabulary term exists specifically for an enum-value widen; classified `nested-field-additive` on the same reasoning plan.schema.json's 1.3.0 -> 1.4.0 note records — it carries the identical holding/bilateral-sequencing risk shape, because a consumer holding a stale vendored copy REJECTS a record carrying a new value (the b6baf9e1 failure class this file's version gate exists to close). Claude-klabauter vendors this schema and already carries both enum members in its vendored copy; what its copy still lacks after this bump is the version string itself.
description: Improvement-queue record — a captured universal or project-scoped improvement pattern awaiting triage. Unknown fields are tolerated (not rejected): this preserves forward-compatibility as new optional fields are added without invalidating existing records. Decision: keep open; tighten only if strict-mode corpus conformance enforcement is required at a future governance stage.
_additionalProperties_note: Permissive by design — additionalProperties is not set to false here. Unknown fields in improvement-queue records are tolerated (not rejected), consistent with the additionalProperties-posture: open header on the legacy YAML DSL source. A misspelled field will silently pass. This is intentional for forward-compatibility and matches the existing permissive pattern in other coordinator schemas.

created.description: Date this improvement-queue entry was captured (YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: Short display title for this improvement.

body.description: Full prose description of the observed pattern or issue prompting this queue entry.

status.description: Lifecycle status. open=awaiting triage; closed=resolved (closure is git mv to archive/improvement-queue/<YYYY-MM>/, never marked resolved in place); deferred=explicitly deprioritized with an architectural reason.

surface.description: The tool, doc, skill, hook, or agent surface this improvement concerns.

proposed_action.description: Concrete proposed remediation or change for this entry.

from_repo.description: Repo of origin for this entry — the repo where the pattern was observed or the memo originated.

change_kind.description: Category of change the proposed_action implies — routes triage to the appropriate handling. SSOT for the enum: docs/wiki/lessons-outbox-schema.md § Change-kind enum. 'verification' is the one member whose deliverable is evidence rather than a diff (a hardware- or environment-gated re-run); a defect it finds gets its own entry with a change-shaped kind.

closed_at.description: Date this entry was closed (YYYY-MM-DD). Present only once status transitions to closed.

closed_by.description: Session or agent identifier that closed this entry.

tags.description: Free-form classification tags for triage and search.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence — file:line citation, log excerpt, or reference substantiating the observed pattern.

case_against.description: OPTIONAL. The argument that lost — carried through from a plan deferral this entry was harvested from, so a triager sees both the case for doing the work (proposed_action/body) and the case against it. Populated by the claude-klabauter-side harvest carry-through as of claude-klabauter 697b7d451, and it MUST stay optional even so: the carry-through OMITS the field entirely when the source row has none rather than writing an empty string, because an omitted optional field says nothing was carried while an empty string asserts there was no argument. Pre-1.6.0 plan rows are the common case there. A required field here would reject exactly those legitimately-omitting entries.

queue_scope.description: central=universal pattern routed to the central improvement queue (claude-klabauter-resident); project=project-scoped entry local to this repo's state/improvement-queue/.

initiative.description: FK to state/initiatives/<id>.yaml; nullable — absent is equivalent to null. Spec backlink: pln-initiative-govern-sweep-priori-6cf808 § C0

system.description: Nested provenance/system-tracking sub-object — all children are optional.

created_by_session.description: Session identifier that authored this entry.

created_by_agent.description: Agent type/persona that authored this entry.

linked_sessions.description: Session identifiers linked to this entry's history.

linked_commits.description: Commit SHAs linked to this entry's history.

provenance_completeness.description: Whether the provenance chain (session/agent/commits) for this entry is fully known.

pm_approved.description: Records that the PM gate authorising this deferral fired. For a ceremony park (/debt-triage Step 6b class 4) the ceremony asserts its own gate; it is not a second approval act by the PM. No ceremony parks bug rows today -- /bug-blitz has no park step -- so a deferred bug row is hand-authored and the grant is the author's to state. Same field name as plan-tasks.schema.json's shipped gate -- one vocabulary across surfaces, deliberately.

deferred_by.description: Who granted the deferral: for a ceremony park, the ceremony identifier plus the session that ran it. Mirrors closed_by.

deferred_until.description: ISO date the deferral expires. Its presence is what makes a due-list a read of grants rather than a corpus scan; its absence is how a parked record drifts unnoticed.

why_blocked.description: Why this entry is deferred. Required in doctrine whenever status=deferred.
